requirements_before_activation: document the secrets and connector boundary for external APIs
decide the V1 interaction surface before selecting a default backend
choose a local model routing policy between 0.5B speed and 1.5B quality
keep Tier 2 CTOS tools behind the approval queue
avoid broad shell, filesystem, or desktop authority for the model
